rule: 先列 Methods 下全部标题（Ethics／Design 与 Step 1–7），再按位置取标题以 Step 开头的七个；禁用标题去重

steps.label: S1
steps.title: Step 1 – Development of the scope and definition of the Style of Delivery Ontology
steps.input: 字典与关键论文（Dombrowski et al., 2016；Hagger & Hardcastle, 2014 等）
steps.output: 『style of delivery』的初步定义与本体的范围界定

steps.label: S2
steps.title: Step 2 – Identifying key entities and developing the preliminary Style of Delivery Ontology
steps.input: Step 1 的初步定义与范围；100 篇已发表干预报告（自下而上）；经 Ontology Lookup Service 检索的既有本体（自上而下）
steps.output: Style of Delivery Ontology 的初步原型版本

steps.label: S3
steps.title: Step 3 – Refining the ontology through literature annotation, discussion and revision
steps.input: Step 2 的初步本体；100 篇干预评估报告（EPPI-Reviewer 4，两人结对独立标注）
steps.output: 经标注、讨论与修订后的本体（实体增删与定义修订）

steps.label: S4
steps.title: Step 4 – Expert stakeholder review
steps.input: Step 3 产出的本体；25 位受邀专家利益相关者（Qualtrics 在线问卷）
steps.output: 专家反馈处理后的修订本体

steps.label: S5
steps.title: Step 5 – Inter-rater reliability of annotations using the Style of Delivery Ontology
steps.input: Step 4 后的本体；两批各 50 篇论文（熟悉与不熟悉本体的标注者各一批）
steps.output: Krippendorff's Alpha 信度评估结果与据此的进一步修订

steps.label: S6
steps.title: Step 6 – Specifying relationships between Style of Delivery Ontology entities
steps.input: 此前各步确定的实体集；Basic Formal Ontology 原则与 Relation Ontology
steps.output: 实体间关系的形式化（含 is_a 层级与 is process attribute of）

steps.label: S7
steps.title: Step 7 – Disseminating and maintaining the Style of Delivery Ontology
steps.input: 定稿的 Style of Delivery Ontology（ROBOT 模板转换为 OWL）
steps.output: GitHub 发布与版本化、Ontology Lookup Service 与 BSSO Foundry 收录
